items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So Fritz Pollard (I saw him on the air the other night; he's a very old man)

ctx.x: Yes, Mel Williams. He was an All-American. Him and Fritz Pollard were on the same team, one of them teams that ran over everybody in the Eastern League...what do you call that league...? The Ivy League.
